origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 18 November 2026 at Steven Powell's request for an electronics room, 'Everyday Electronics': a live circuit bench (battery, switch, bulb; sliders for volts and ohms; current and power computed and shown), an Ohm's law bench that solves any one of V/I/R from the other two with the working shown, an LED resistor bench (typical forward-voltage presets, exact value plus the nearest E12 value rounded up, resistor power checked), a labeled signal-flow diagram and five-step plain-language walk-through of how a crystal radio works (antenna, coil + variable capacitor resonance, crystal/1N34A detection, high-impedance earpiece, and no battery — the transmitter supplies the energy), four build plans (the crystal radio — the 3-penny/foxhole idea told as history with the diode as the practical detector, with plain antenna/thunderstorm safety lines; a fruit battery with an orange front and centre at an honest ≈0.9 V per cell and the series lesson; a paper circuit; an LED throwie), a verified six-link shelf (PhET Circuit Construction Kit, Falstad, All About Circuits, Adafruit Learn, SparkFun Learn, Khan Academy), a plain-language workshop on loops/Ohm's law/series and parallel/polarity/power as heat, and a Help menu with full documentation. At Steven's explicit request The Radio Room links to this room and this room links back. No upstream original exists; the collection copy is the maintained original.
